title: pyrus poilanei
intro: Pyrus poilanei, commonly known as the Vietnamese wild pear, is a species of pear tree native to Vietnam. This plant is valued for its multiple health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus poilanei include its potential to protect against oxidative stress, improve lipid profiles, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus poilanei include polyphenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
